visibility.description: Visibility tier. `shared` applies the group-permission map; `private` ignores groups and uses owner + sharedWith for access.

groupPermissions.description: Map of group UUID -> { use, manage } booleans. Empty object when visibility is `private`.
groupPermissions.title: Grouppermissions

guardrails.description: Free-form guardrail labels enforced at run time (e.g. PII redaction profile names).
guardrails.title: Guardrails

sharedWith.description: Per-user share entries used for private-visibility scopes.
sharedWith.title: Sharedwith

ownerUserId.description: Clerk user id of the scope owner. Set on first write; cannot be changed by clients.
ownerUserId.title: Owneruserid

ownerEmail.description: Lowercased email of the scope owner. Used by private-scope ACL when owner email matches.
ownerEmail.title: Owneremail

use.description: Whether members of this group may use (run / invoke) the scope.
use.title: Use

manage.description: Whether members of this group may manage (edit / deploy / delete) the scope.
manage.title: Manage

pendingOwnerUserId.description: Clerk user id of the org member who will become owner once they accept.
pendingOwnerUserId.title: Pendingowneruserid

pendingOwnerEmail.description: Email of the pending recipient, resolved from org membership at request time.
pendingOwnerEmail.title: Pendingowneremail

requestedByUserId.description: Clerk user id of the member who requested the transfer (the current owner).
requestedByUserId.title: Requestedbyuserid

email.description: Lowercased email of a user explicitly granted access to a private scope.
email.title: Email

addedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which this user was added to the share list.
addedAt.title: Addedat

addedBy.description: Clerk user id of the principal that added this share entry.
addedBy.title: Addedby

userId.description: Clerk user id of the invited user. Stored for display; access checks use email.
userId.title: Userid

permission.description: Per-invitee access level for private scopes. `manage` grants edit / deploy / delete (implies use); `use` (default) grants run-only.

expectedOutput.description: Free-form expected-output prompt that constrains the scope’s reply.
examples: A 3-bullet summary highlighting churn risk drivers.
expectedOutput.title: Expectedoutput

instructions.description: Ordered list of instruction blocks. Each entry is a free-form string the builder rendered into the system prompt.
instructions.title: Instructions

model.description: Provider-prefixed model id. The orchestrator routes by prefix.
model.title: Model

toolset.description: Builder-managed toolset descriptor. Map of `{toolName: config}`; opaque to the API surface.
toolset.title: Toolset

connectionSet.description: Connection selections (DBs, integrations) attached to the variation. Each entry is a builder-managed object; opaque here.
connectionSet.title: Connectionset

contextSelections.description: Context selections attached to the variation. Free-form builder objects.
contextSelections.title: Contextselections

evaluations.description: Evaluation entries (task + expected-output pairs) saved for this variation.
evaluations.title: Evaluations

interfaces.description: Interface entries attached to the variation (chat, slack, webhook, etc.). Each is a builder-managed object.
interfaces.title: Interfaces

supervisionSubordinateIds.description: IDs of scopes supervised by this scope (when it is a manager). Stringified for wire stability.
supervisionSubordinateIds.title: Supervisionsubordinateids

supervisionSubordinateDescriptions.description: Map of subordinateId -> manager-provided description blurb.
supervisionSubordinateDescriptions.title: Supervisionsubordinatedescriptions

id.description: Numeric scope id (stable per-org; not reused after delete).
id.title: Id

slug.description: URL-safe slug used in human-readable links. Unique per org.
slug.title: Slug

name.description: Display name of the scope. Shown in the builder and in run logs.
name.title: Name

description.description: Optional one-paragraph description of what this scope does.
examples: Predicts churn risk for a customer given a 90-day usage window.
description.title: Description

status.description: Lifecycle status. `draft` = never deployed. `active` = deployed. `deleted` = soft-deleted.

orgUuid.description: Org UUID this scope belongs to. Matches the caller’s principal.
orgUuid.title: Orguuid

activeVariationId.description: Active (deployed) variation id. Null until the scope is first deployed.
activeVariationId.title: Activevariationid

draftVariationId.description: Most recent draft variation id. Null when there is no draft pending.
draftVariationId.title: Draftvariationid

hasUnpublishedChanges.description: True when the draft variation differs from the active variation (deploy would publish changes).
hasUnpublishedChanges.title: Hasunpublishedchanges

accessConfig.description: Access configuration — who in the org can use / manage this scope.

pendingOwnershipTransfer.description: Pending ownership transfer awaiting recipient acceptance. Absent when no request is in flight.

variation.description: Variation-detail payload (`toolset`, `instructions`, `model`, etc.) for the requested view. Present on detail responses; absent on list rows.

deletedAt.description: Soft-delete timestamp. Null for active scopes.
deletedAt.title: Deletedat

canManage.description: Whether the requesting principal can manage (edit/delete/deploy) this scope. Derived server-side from the principal + accessConfig. Present on every Scope response.
canManage.title: Canmanage

canUse.description: Whether the requesting principal can use (run, view history of) this scope. Derived server-side from the principal + accessConfig.
canUse.title: Canuse

manageDenial.description: Why `canManage` is false, for client-facing guidance: `needs_group_manage` (shared, but no group you belong to grants Manage) or `not_owner` (private, and you are not the owner). `null` when `canManage` is true.
